decisions.reason: The revised launch deadline and live-publication target do not change the digital PDF deliverable or its two-page-spread display behavior.
Requiring the flipbook to be live by a revised deadline does not change the existing free-hosting constraint or candidate platform list; the timing remains owned by the source Requirement.
The launch deadline change does not alter the article-ending whitespace standard or the selected balancing methods.
The revised launch timing does not change the requirement to enhance low-quality publication images when needed.
The source decision does not add, remove, or otherwise change any required issue content.
The revised flipbook launch deadline does not change author-name, author-photo, sizing, shape, coverage, or source requirements.
The source decision changes launch timing, not the requirement that advertisements render clearly.
The table of contents must still use finalized, correct pagination; the revised launch deadline does not change that state.
The launch timing does not change how long article text should be broken up with images, blurbs, or quotes.
The revised deadline does not alter the flat-plan basis, article placement, tribute placement, or editorial order.
The source decision does not change the magazine's visual style, branding reference, or color-use rules.
The revised launch deadline does not change the selected Inter typeface, weight treatment, or readability requirement.
